card.why: Breakout idea #105 (new family, owner's 100 list, 2026-10-28): 30-minute opening range break with the daily trend, because the stops of the traders on the other side of the break feed the move.
card.loser: Traders on the wrong side of the break whose stops get hit.
card.sides_why: A break can go either way, one rule.
card.loses_when: Chop days where the break reverses at once.
